adjudication.mechanics: FUN_00b1fdb0 is a four-byte ECX-receiver accessor that returns the raw 32-bit word at receiver+0x54. The committed decompiler record says __fastcall, while the no-stack-argument shape is thiscall-like; the formal calling-convention label remains decompiler-dependent.

adjudication.decision: The mixed scalar/pointer contradiction is resolved in favor of a pointer. Scalar-looking uses are 32-bit pointer equality/null tests. Multiple direct dereferences, exact cCreatureBase vtable-slot matches, and an action record carrying the returned address rule out an integer ID, tagged value, or union.
